'''Riij Brinwell''' was a [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Ranger]] operating in the [[Parmic sector/Legends|Parmic sector]]. Holding the rank of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]], Brinwell was considered to be knowledgeable about space [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and their use throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SWTSE" />
